item.description:
Annotations across your entire canvas

  • Add arrows, shapes, callouts and text inside or outside the device frame.
  • Adjust colors, fonts, outlines and shadows with sliders, steppers and quick presets.
  • Start with larger, readable annotations and reuse your selected styling.
  • Let connected AI agents create, edit, duplicate and arrange annotations through MCP.
  • Updated agent instructions include full-canvas coordinates and worked examples.

Keep project exports together

  • Export Project as PNGs now creates a folder named after your project inside the destination you choose, with all images contained in that folder.
  • Repeated exports create numbered folders, keeping previous exports intact.
  • Each image keeps its edits, redactions, style, and output dimensions. Project export includes every image, even when search hides it.

Export an entire project

  • Choose Export Project as PNGs from the Export menu, File menu, or project menu to save all of a project's images to one folder.
  • Each PNG includes its image's edits, redactions, style, and output dimensions. All project images are included, even when search hides them.
  • Existing files are kept. Follow export progress, cancel when needed, and keep images that have already finished exporting.
